import pathlib,json,hashlib,re,datetime
s=pathlib.Path('bench-results/efficiency-mechanism-isolation-20260906T214448Z').resolve();p=s/'phases/author-joint-integration-20260915'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
canonical=lambda x:sha(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode())
reference_path=s/'screens/author-feedback-20260914/catalog-immutability-016/ACTUAL-QUALIFICATION-20260915.json'
reference=json.loads(reference_path.read_text())['sources']['reference']
without=lambda rows:[{k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='line'} for row in rows]
fields=['model','effort','approval_policy','approvals_reviewer','sandbox_policy','permission_profile','personality','collaboration_mode','multi_agent_version','realtime_active','summary']
def inputs(path):
 raw=path.read_bytes();rows=[json.loads(x) for x in raw.splitlines()]
 meta=next(x['payload'] for x in rows if x['type']=='session_meta')
 dev=[];contexts=[];states=[];users=[];admin=[]
 for line,e in enumerate(rows,1):
  q=e.get('payload',{})
  if e['type']=='response_item' and q.get('type')=='message':
   body='\n'.join(v.get('text','') for v in q.get('content',[]) if 'text' in v)
   if q.get('role') in ('system','developer'):dev.append(dict(role=q['role'],bytes=len(body.encode()),sha256=sha(body.encode())))
   elif q.get('role')=='user':users.append(body)
  if e['type']=='turn_context':contexts.append({k:q.get(k) for k in fields})
  if e['type']=='world_state' and 'permissions' in q.get('state',{}):states.append(dict(full=q['full'],permissions=q['state']['permissions']))
  if e['type']=='response_item' and q.get('type')=='function_call':
   args=q.get('arguments','')
   if re.search(r'git\s+(?:[^\n]*\s)?reflog\b|\.git/(?:logs|FETCH_HEAD|ORIG_HEAD)',args):admin.append({'line':line,'arguments':args})
 return {'path':str(path),'sha256':sha(raw),'meta':meta,'dev':dev,'contexts':contexts,'states':states,'users':users,'administrative_reads':admin}
ref=inputs(pathlib.Path(reference['path']));assert ref['sha256']==reference['sha256']
def environment(body,cwd):
 normalized=body.replace(cwd,'<CHECKOUT>')
 dates=re.findall(r'<current_date>([^<]+)</current_date>',normalized)
 assert len(dates)==1
 return re.sub(r'<current_date>[^<]+</current_date>','<current_date><RUN_DATE></current_date>',normalized),dates[0]
refuser,refdate=environment(ref['users'][0],ref['meta']['cwd'])
manifest=json.loads((p/'PHASE-MANIFEST.json').read_text())
source_mismatches=[f['path'] for f in manifest['files'] if sha(pathlib.Path(f['path']).read_bytes())!=f['sha256']]
results=[]
for n in ('004','005','006'):
 rid='author-joint-integration-'+n;a=p/'runs'/rid/(rid+'-three-feature-sequential-bench-artifacts')
 audit_path=p/'postcapture'/rid/'NATIVE-USAGE-POPULATION-SUPPLEMENT.json';audit=json.loads(audit_path.read_text())
 x=inputs(pathlib.Path(audit['threads'][0]['native_path']));user,date=environment(x['users'][0],x['meta']['cwd'])
 source=json.loads((a/'runs/CONTINUATION-SOURCE.json').read_text());cache=json.loads((a/'runs/CONTINUATION-CACHE.json').read_text())
 checks={'closed_native_pin':x['sha256']==audit['threads'][0]['native_sha256'],
 'base_instructions':canonical(x['meta'].get('base_instructions'))==reference['base_instructions_sha256'],
 'whole_developer':x['dev']==without(reference['developer']),
 'whole_contexts':x['contexts']==without(reference['contexts']),
 'whole_permissions':x['states']==without(reference['permissions']),
 'cli_provider':x['meta']['cli_version']==reference['cli_version'] and x['meta']['model_provider']==reference['model_provider'],
 'repository_and_catalog_user_input_except_declared_cwd_date':user==refuser,
 'all_user_messages_accounted':len(x['users'])==3,
 'exact_reference_plan_prompt':x['users'][1]==ref['users'][1],
 'exact_reference_accept_prompt':x['users'][2]==ref['users'][2],
 'exact_restored_source':all(source[k] for k in ['clean','source_refs_preserved','all_ref_commit_graph_matches']),
 'all_manifest_pins':not source_mismatches,
 'closed_owned_accounting':audit['status']=='qualified_observed_ledger' and not audit['errors'] and not audit['capture_qualification']['unknown_unfinished_tail_observed']}
 results.append({'run_id':rid,'thread':x['meta']['id'],'native_path':x['path'],'native_sha256':x['sha256'],'audit_path':str(audit_path),'audit_sha256':sha(audit_path.read_bytes()),'checks':checks,'passed':all(checks.values()),'declared_environment':{'reference_cwd':ref['meta']['cwd'],'actual_cwd':x['meta']['cwd'],'reference_date':refdate,'actual_date':date,'normalized_user_sha256':sha(user.encode())},'administrative_reads':x['administrative_reads'],'source':source,'cache':cache,'native_raw':audit['native_usage']['raw_input_plus_output'],'final_workflow_result':audit['workflow_result']})
result={'at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'closed input/source/accounting qualification; cached totals only, no native core execution; does not turn a workflow failure into pass','manifest_sha256':sha((p/'PHASE-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()),'pins_checked':len(manifest['files']),'source_mismatches':source_mismatches,'reference':{'path':reference['path'],'sha256':reference['sha256'],'qualification_sha256':sha(reference_path.read_bytes())},'runs':results}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
assert all(x['passed'] for x in results)
PY
